requirements_to_testpoints.requirement_text:
点亮一个连接在 D13 引脚的 LED，并保持常亮。
验收约定：初始化完成后 20ms 内点亮，随后保持常亮。
requirements_to_testpoints.stimulus: no inputs (initialization then steady control steps)
requirements_to_testpoints.oracle: io_0 remains true continuously; LED driven ON on/after initialization and stays ON
